newsitem.title: LATVIA: GROBINA, MADONA PUBLIC OFFER COMPLETE.
newsitem.headline: GROBINA, MADONA PUBLIC OFFER COMPLETE.

text.p: Riga stock exchange said on Wednesday that companies Grobina and Madona have completed their public offer with all shares sold for privatisation vouchers.
The price of one Grobina share at auction was five lats and Madona saw its price fixed at 4.14 lats, the bourse said in a statement.
A bourse spokeswoman said that the shares would at some time be quoted on the stock exchange but did not say when.
Some 17,204 vouchers were cancelled in buying Grobina shares and 9528 vouchers acquiring Madona stocks.
The figures still have to be confirmed by the Latvian Privatisation Agency, the statement said.
